excerpts.content:
Hello! Big news: ethlambda, Lean Ethereum consensus client, is adding support for Ethereum mainnet
https://x.com/ethlambda_lean/status/2105304986930536626

We're currently finishing work on the Validator API and testing Glamsterdam support. Performance is already at around 500ms per block, but we have some improvements in the pipeline that should make this match the performance of other clients.

Feedback is more than welcome
